name: standing calf raise circle
description: A calf raise that finishes with a small circle of the heels. It works the calves and the ankle control.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and hold a support if needed.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Trace a small circle with your heels while staying high.
Lower your heels slowly to the floor.
Reverse the circle direction on the next rep.
Keep your knees straight and your balance steady.
